This is the `swear01/hapi` maintained build based on official HAPI `v0.23.4`, plus upstream `main` through [`d90bde0`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/commit/d90bde0b889bf3a9d461bb8c62f74a5b653cc757).

## Compared with the previous maintained release (`v0.23.3.2`)

- Updated the maintained base from upstream `v0.23.3` to `v0.23.4` and included all upstream changes through `d90bde0`.
- Kept the selected fork patch set, with PR #774 and PR #1028 now supplied by upstream.
- Continued to exclude Codex local-session import and its follow-up paths while preserving normal HAPI resume, Fast, Plan, personality, and transcript behavior.

## Compared with the official release (`tiann/hapi v0.23.4`)

- Includes newer upstream `main` changes through `d90bde0`.
- Retains the maintained fork additions for OpenCode stall recovery, macOS Codex Desktop restart, project-group actions, scratchlist promotion, Codex terminal recovery, Fast/personality/Create controls, mid-turn steering, and sidebar name priority.
- Excludes Codex local-session import and its follow-up paths.

## Maintained-fork guarantees

- Release tags must point to commits contained in `main` and match the four-part CLI version.
- macOS binaries are signed with the stable `xyz.hapi.cli` identity.
- Fork builds do not publish over upstream GitHub Pages or update the upstream Homebrew formula.
- The app shell is served with no-store cache headers.
